stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Bridge or ford? Can we fly?
stations.note: Decides it all in her head.

captions: A wet Tuesday at the base. Rhona has to plan the route to a callout.
Today she decides from memory, and a tired guess sends the team the wrong way.
You write the if, elif and else blocks that decide from tonight's values.
Now the laptop picks the route, the warning and the way off the hill.
Blocks that run only when a condition is true, and the order they are asked in.
